principles.title: Method Runtime is the only Method platform
principles.statementZhHans: Method Runtime 是唯一 Method 平台。
principles.rule: PHI OS has exactly one Method Runtime Platform. A method cannot create, fork or rename a second Method Runtime.

principles.title: Every Method must register as a Plugin
principles.statementZhHans: 所有 Method 必须以 Plugin 注册。
principles.rule: Every Method registers as a governed Plugin. A method-specific engine executes inside the shared platform and is not an independent Runtime.

principles.title: Method Definition before Runtime
principles.statementZhHans: Method Definition 必须先于 Runtime。
principles.rule: An IMR-governed Method Definition must exist before Runtime execution. Runtime cannot invent a Method.

principles.title: One Data Authority
principles.rule: Birth, coordinate, timezone, DST, true solar time, astronomy, calendar, solar terms and reference tables use one shared Data Authority and belong to no individual Method.

principles.title: Projection is not Interpretation
principles.rule: Projection JSON contains governed method output only. It is neither Interpretation nor Professional judgment.

principles.title: Interpretation is not a Professional Conclusion
principles.rule: Interpretation produces an Interpretation Candidate and cannot automatically become a formal Professional Conclusion.

principles.title: Provider does not participate in Calculation
principles.rule: OpenAI, Workers AI, prompts and interpretive Providers cannot participate in Calculation or create calculation facts.

principles.title: Independent Professional Review
principles.rule: Professional review, boundary validation, deliverable assembly, signature and release remain independent from Calculation, Projection and Interpretation.

principles.title: Every Plugin must pass IMR
principles.statementZhHans: 所有 Plugin 必须通过 IMR。
principles.rule: Every Plugin must pass Interpretive Method Governance for scope, algorithm, data authority, validation, license, commercial rights and production eligibility.

principles.title: Every Plugin follows one Lifecycle
principles.statementZhHans: 所有 Plugin 必须遵守统一 Lifecycle。
principles.rule: Every Plugin follows the same lifecycle states and legal transitions; version and license evidence remain explicit and auditable.

principles.title: Method Runtime remains independent
principles.statementZhHans: Method Runtime 永远独立于 Journey、Knowledge 与 Professional Workspace。
principles.rule: Method Runtime remains independent from Journey Runtime, Knowledge Runtime and Professional Workspace. Optional integrations are adapter-bound and never required dependencies.
